purpose: Exact source-code compatibility analysis for work/learning numeric needs; independent companion to the 563-action semantic coverage artifact. Activity-level evidence/support stays in tracker_work_learning_quantitative_needs.json.

sourceRevision.verification: git bundle list-heads on supplied read-only bundle reports this hash at refs/heads/main and HEAD; extracted directory has no .git metadata, so live rev-parse was unavailable. delivery-manifest.json also names the same commit.
sourceRevision.scope: Actual implementation inspected in the supplied extracted source tree.

classificationLegend.representable: The explicitly bounded scalar/time value can be stored without changing its stated meaning, assuming the user deliberately defines a Metric and valid unit. This does not mean a catalog/UI exists or that any cross-target aggregation is automatically justified.
classificationLegend.lossy: A manual aggregate value can be stored, but one or more declared context, identity, stage, lineage, or deduplication dimensions are not structured. Scope IDs/metric IDs may isolate some cases; they do not add object/event identity.
classificationLegend.needs-schema: The exact quantity cannot safely be represented under current accepted value/scope/aggregation semantics; a signed value or non-time target/state/basis is required. A user may still store any custom local data they choose; this is compatibility analysis, not an input prohibition.

UnitDefinition.conversion: same dimension; exact BigDecimal conversion through factorToBase; incompatible or nonterminating conversion rejected, never rounded

Measurement.scopeTargets: SESSION targetId is a Session ID; SEGMENT targetId is a Segment ID
Measurement.value: Decimal encoded as nonnegative plain string; up to 1024 chars; Decimal strips trailing zeros
Measurement.registeredMetricRules: unit must equal canonicalUnitId; scope must be allowed; scale must be <= maxScale. Integer requires maxScale=0 in Metric definition.
Measurement.unregisteredFieldRules: Unknown v1/user field returns early from registered-metric validation; its explicit field ID/version/unit survive without guessed mapping. Dataset still requires nonnegative value and valid scope target.
Measurement.uniqueConstraint: one tuple (fieldId, meaningVersion, unit, scope, targetId); duplicate rejected

aggregationAndReports.selection: Report rows are time-window/filter slices; measurements selected afterward by whether their SESSION/SEGMENT target is among selected rows.
aggregationAndReports.targetMeaning: Report measurements are whole-target values, not values within the report window. This behavior is explicitly specified in docs/UI_CONTRACT.md:49.
aggregationAndReports.quantityTotals: distinct measurement IDs; only a defined metric with aggregation BY_TARGET is excluded. Others group by (fieldId, meaningVersion, unit, scope) and sum exact Decimal. Metric target IDs are not retained in total map.
aggregationAndReports.repeatedWholeTarget: The same SESSION Measurement is intentionally present in every date/classification report that includes one of its segments. UI_CONTRACT.md says display as for the whole session/segment and never sum across daily reports. This is not an implementation defect under that contract.
aggregationAndReports.csv: one row per target Measurement with field/version/unit/value/scope/target ID, no time apportionment. Measurement.source is not emitted as a CSV column.
aggregationAndReports.unknownMetric: Because the report filter is `metric?.aggregation != BY_TARGET`, a field with no registered Metric is treated as a SUM/legacy field in quantityTotals; consistent with docs/CATALOG_IMPACT.md:17, which says legacy fields aggregate by identifiers.

persistenceAndUi.Room: Measurement rows are JSON payloads; dictionaries are in metadata dataset payload. Backup v2 preserves Dataset including measurements/metrics/units.
persistenceAndUi.api: Tracker.measure stores a supplied Measurement; `Dataset.prepareMeasurement` converts to canonical unit without rounding or keeps draft on error.
persistenceAndUi.userInterface: MainActivity is a technical harness and has no quantity-entry or quantity-report UI; core support is not a user-visible integrated feature.
persistenceAndUi.bootstrap: catalog-bootstrap.json contains 5 activity types and no axes/metrics/units. No quantitative Metric or UnitDefinition is preloaded.

actualCoreContract.contractLimitations: Aggregation labels do not validate semantic disjointness or object identity; `SUM` adds exactly what is present. No object/event/work-set target, state dimension, signed decimal, text/document lineage, or window-apportionment for quantities. This is a schema/contract boundary, not a claim that arbitrary user input is forbidden.

quantities.definitionRu: Длительность фактически записанных интервалов; это единственная базовая количественная величина по таймеру. Не подразумевает полноту записи дня.
scope: segment; report/session is a deduplicated aggregation of unique segments
quantities.aggregationRu: Суммировать только уникальные фактические неперекрывающиеся интервалы; явные паузы исключены. Фасетные/контекстные выборки могут пересекаться и не складываются как части суток.
quantities.coreMapping: Not a Metric/Measurement. Segment.durationMs is the time quantity; Segment start/end and optional Anchor provide interval evidence. Scope is unique Segment; session/report duration is a deduplicated sum of unique segments, with explicit pauses represented by segment gaps.
quantities.coreAggregation: Use core interval computation. Metric would create a second competing time counter. Reports apportion elapsed time only for report-window slices; exact whole-segment values remain durationMs.

quantities.definitionRu: Количество независимых новых результатов одного выбранного типа (например, документ, рисунок, сцена, эпизод, модель или изделие), созданных в явно выбранной области. Точное определение того, что считать одним результатом, пользователь задаёт сам.
quantities.unit: item of one named output type (not generic interchangeable items)
scope: session
work/event
project/object-set, chosen explicitly
quantities.aggregationRu: Сумма отдельных новых результатов одного и того же output_type в совместимых не перекрывающихся областях. Редактирование уже существующего артефакта не создаёт новый результат автоматически; объектный накопительный итог не дублируется по каждому segment.
quantities.coreMapping: Metric INTEGER, maxScale=0, named canonical count unit, SESSION or SEGMENT Measurement. A metric ID/version can name one output class; scalar totals fit. No project/object-set scope or output-object identity.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM only when the entered totals are non-overlapping new outputs of that same declared type; BY_TARGET preserves each session/segment value. Edits are not new outputs, but core cannot enforce this.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: A typed object/set target or output identity is needed for cross-session dedup/reconciliation; distinct metric IDs can represent user-selected aggregate classes now.

quantities.definitionRu: Количество реально прочитанных страниц конкретного произведения/издания; номер страницы/текущая позиция — отдельное значение.
scope: reading session/segment or session, chosen explicitly; tied to work and edition
quantities.aggregationRu: Суммировать лишь объёмы одинакового произведения и издания в неперекрывающихся областях; перечитывание — повторное чтение, не новые уникальные страницы. Номер текущей/последней страницы не складывать.
quantities.coreMapping: Metric INTEGER/maxScale=0/unit.page, SESSION or SEGMENT Measurement. A user aggregate pages-read value fits exactly; work/edition/count-vs-position/re-reading lineage is not a structured field.
quantities.coreAggregation: For reading volume, user-chosen SUM across books can be a valid page-count total (page lengths differ, so comparison caveat); for unique pages covered, require same work/edition and deduplicate spans. Re-reading can mean additional reading volume but not new unique coverage. Core cannot distinguish these.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: A reading-object/version or passage identity would be needed for structured unique-page coverage; no blanket prohibition on aggregate pages read.

quantities.definitionRu: Количество уникальных экземпляров одного явно названного вида события. У события отдельно выбирается статус/исход: запланировано, состоялось/проведено, попытка, отменено, неявка и т.п.; отмена/неявка не являются состоявшимся выполнением. Люди/участники не подразумеваются.
quantities.unit: one event of one user-defined kind and one separately selected status
scope: unique event
session/explicit set only when the user knows the included event identities or deduplicated total
quantities.aggregationRu: Суммировать только уникальные события одного kind+status в не перекрывающемся event set. Planned/cancelled/no-show/attempted/held/completed являются различными state views и не суммируются как состоявшиеся события. Одно событие не копируется по activity labels, pause, hand-off или timer splits; число timer segments никогда не даёт event count.
quantities.coreMapping: Metric INTEGER/maxScale=0 can store a manual aggregate for one declared event kind/status on a SESSION or SEGMENT. event kind/status can be isolated through distinct metric IDs/versions, but event identity/state is not modeled.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM by metric ID only if event identities are disjoint and status/kind definitions match. BY_TARGET keeps independent session/segment totals. No timer-segment-derived event count.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: Full event dedup and multi-state event records need event-target and state dimensions; session aggregate remains possible.

quantities.definitionRu: Количество уникальных рабочих объектов одного названного типа (например, task/issue/request/case/invoice/contract/order/application/document/sample order), с одним явно выбранным этапом/состоянием счёта: начато, затронуто, проверено, закрыто, подано, принято и т.п. Документ может быть самим выбранным объектом; несколько документов/действий по одному case не считаются новыми case автоматически. Люди не являются work items по этой семантике.
quantities.unit: one item of one declared object class and one separately selected stage/status
scope: work object or batch
session/event if total explicitly covers those objects
quantities.aggregationRu: Суммировать одинаковые object_class+stage/status только по distinct объектам и совместимым неперекрывающимся наборам. Объект может фигурировать на нескольких отдельных стадиях; стадийные totals — раздельные views и не складываются в суммарный выпуск. Whole-object total хранить один раз; split timer не размножает work order/object total.
quantities.coreMapping: Metric INTEGER count can store a manually chosen total per SESSION/SEGMENT; object class/stage can be encoded only informally in Metric ID/name. Object identity/list, project/batch scope, and status transitions are absent.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM only under same item class/stage and disjoint object sets; BY_TARGET is a whole session/segment value. Cannot deduplicate an item touched across sessions.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: Full item lifecycle/dedup needs object identity, object class and selected stage/state in schema.

quantities.definitionRu: Количество записей одного выбранного entity type (например, record, report, study или source) в одном заданном наборе и на одной стадии: найдено, дедуплицировано, просмотрено/screened, retrieved, assessed, excluded, included. Record, полный report/publication и underlying study не взаимозаменяемы.
quantities.unit: record, report, study, source (exactly one named entity type per measure)
scope: research set/project and named screening stage
session only if explicitly a count of items processed in that session
quantities.aggregationRu: Суммировать лишь одинаковый entity type, source set/version и stage; один и тот же объект, прошедший несколько этапов, учитывается по одной строке в каждом отдельном stage view, но этапные totals не складываются в общий выпуск. Дубликаты и excluded/included отличаются.
quantities.coreMapping: Integer aggregate fits Measurement. Record/report/study/source kind, research-set identity, stage and record ID do not have structured dimensions; separate metric IDs can name distinct aggregates.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM only for same entity kind/stage over disjoint sets. No automatic mapping from sessions/activities or record identity.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: Full record-stage counts across sets need entity kind/set/record/state or target references.

quantities.nameRu: Количество respondent cases по выбранному статусу
quantities.definitionRu: Количество respondent/participant cases в одном явно названном исследовательском sample/wave по одному отдельно выбранному disposition/status: приглашён, контактирован/попытка, ответил, частично/полностью завершил, отказался, не подошёл и т.п. Количество проведённых интервью/сессий — другая величина. Идентификационные/описательные данные не являются частью единицы или определения этого счётчика.
quantities.unit: respondent/participant case per explicitly named sample/wave and one state
scope: named research sample and collection wave
session/event only if user manually knows and selects the respondent cases covered
quantities.aggregationRu: Считать каждый case один раз в выбранной state/disposition view; попытки контакта — отдельные event values, не число уникальных respondent cases. Несколько waves/повторных ответов/стадий не складывать без case identity and stage policy. Не складывать числа invited/contacted/partial/completed как независимых лиц.
quantities.coreMapping: Integer aggregate fits for a user-selected respondent/case count. Sample/wave identity, participant identity, stage/state are not Measurement fields; optional free local info is not prohibited.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM requires same sample/wave/status semantics and disjoint cases. BY_TARGET stores whole session/segment values only. Numeric count does not imply outcomes or identity.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: Full case state/dedup needs sample/wave and respondent-case identity/state dimensions. Treat privacy/minimization as a recommendation under the user's choice, never as an engine prohibition.

quantities.definitionRu: Количество уникальных физических образцов/specimens/test items одного ясно названного типа, собранных, принятых или поданных в проверку. Один sample — объект, а не измерение, повторное наблюдение, test run, участник или строка данных.
quantities.unit: sample/specimen/test item (count of one declared class)
scope: unique collection, project, batch or test order
session only if the number of new samples is known for that session
quantities.aggregationRu: Суммировать distinct sample identities only within same sample class/material and collection or work-order scope. Re-reading/remeasuring the same sample is not a new sample; one sample may have several separately counted measurement events. Do not copy order-level totals onto each timer segment.
quantities.coreMapping: Metric INTEGER count fits one chosen sample/specimen/test-item aggregate per SESSION/SEGMENT. Sample-class/batch identity and parent/subsample links are not represented.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM only if counted samples are disjoint and at one chosen granularity; BY_TARGET preserves aggregate value. Distinct observation records are a separate reused definition.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: Full parent/subsample/sample identity requires object target schema; user aggregate remains available.

quantities.definitionRu: Количество физических единиц/штук одного названного product class, произведённых, собранных, установленных, упакованных, осмотренных или обработанных на одной явно выбранной стадии операции. Это повторяемые product units/pieces, не уникальные task/ticket/case; если exact unit уже записан как quantity.output_count, использовать одну семантику, не обе.
quantities.unit: product unit / piece (one named product class)
scope: work order/batch/object set
session only when the amount completed in that session is explicitly known
quantities.aggregationRu: Суммировать один product class и один stage по неперекрывающимся work orders/scopes. Requested, started, produced, accepted, installed, repaired, rejected и scrapped различны; один order total не повторять на каждом timer split. Count unit and package size remain different.
quantities.coreMapping: Metric INTEGER, canonical unit one named product piece/unit, SESSION/SEGMENT Measurement. Product class or stage can be separated by metric ID, not represented as fields; no individual product identity.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM same product class and selected production/processing stage only when disjoint; BY_TARGET is whole session/segment. Acceptance/processing states not derivable from elapsed time.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: Full product/stage identity needs typed object/state target schema.

quantities.definitionRu: Длина одного названного материала, участка монтажа или завершённой линейной работы; installed/processed length must be distinguished from travel distance.
scope: work order/object/route/job
session only for amount actually completed during that scope
quantities.aggregationRu: Sum only same material/object type, method and stage within non-overlapping work orders. Keep demanded/planned/installed/accepted/reworked lengths separate.
quantities.coreMapping: Exact decimal Metric; UnitDefinition.dimension identifies compatible length units and factorToBase enables exact conversion; canonicalUnitId can be m; Measurement scope SESSION/SEGMENT. Scalar amount is representable.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM is valid when user defines the quantity as additive across selected lengths; BY_TARGET for a whole-object/session value. Core does not force users to keep material classes separate; combining them can be an explicit aggregate with detail lost.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: No new schema for one scalar aggregate. Material/site/installed-vs-removed distinction is not a structured dimension; keep separate metrics or add metadata only if user needs it.

quantities.definitionRu: Area of one named surface/plot installed, treated, cleaned, painted, tiled, inspected or restored, with operation stage stated.
scope: work order/surface/plot/event
session only for amount actually completed during that scope
quantities.aggregationRu: Sum only same surface/product, method and stage across non-overlapping regions. Distinguish planned, measured, treated, installed, accepted and rework area.
quantities.coreMapping: Exact decimal Metric and a UnitDefinition dimension for area (e.g. m²), canonical unit and exact factor; Measurement scope SESSION/SEGMENT. Scalar value fits.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM for an explicitly additive area total; BY_TARGET for a particular surface/session. User may aggregate classes by choice; doing so loses category breakdown but is not invalid by default.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: No new schema for a scalar. Surface/site identity and treatment type are not structured.

quantities.definitionRu: Volume of one named material/product explicitly requested, handled, processed, produced, served, removed or accepted; operation/stage must be selected.
quantities.unit: m³ (compatible volume units such as L may be converted exactly)
scope: work order/batch/target/event
session only for amount actually performed in that scope
quantities.aggregationRu: Sum same material/product and stage across unique non-overlapping scopes; do not mix input, planned demand, output and waste volume or duplicate a whole batch total on timer splits.
quantities.coreMapping: Exact decimal Metric and volume UnitDefinition (e.g. m³; litres can convert if the exact factor is registered); scope SESSION/SEGMENT.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM only when user selects compatible additive volumes; BY_TARGET for an object/set. Exact conversion rejects incompatible dimensions or nonterminating division; never silently rounds.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: No new schema for a scalar. Material/product class and source object are not structured.

quantities.definitionRu: Mass of one named material/product explicitly handled, processed, produced, accepted, reworked, scrapped, loaded or delivered, with operation stage specified.
scope: work order/batch/product/event
session only when the mass in that scope is explicitly measured
quantities.aggregationRu: Sum compatible material, scale/source, work order and stage only across non-overlapping totals. Requested, input, consumed, produced, accepted, rejected and waste mass are separate.
quantities.coreMapping: Exact decimal Metric and mass UnitDefinition (e.g. kg), canonical unit and exact factor; scope SESSION/SEGMENT.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM can represent a user-selected total across materials/classes with detail loss; comparable reporting should preserve class/site/product grouping when desired. BY_TARGET retains per-target values.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: No new schema for a scalar aggregate. Core does not assume cross-material aggregates are invalid; user selects the desired grouping.

quantities.nameRu: Количество учебных единиц по выбранному состоянию
quantities.definitionRu: Количество уникальных учебных единиц одного заданного вида (например, lesson/module/exercise/problem/assignment) в одном выбранном состоянии: открыта, в работе, была попытка, завершена, прошла порог и т.п. Единство — это единица курса/материала, а не отдельный ответ/повтор; один и тот же unit может перейти в несколько статусов.
quantities.unit: one named learning unit of one selected unit type and one separately selected state
scope: course/material version/object set
session if unit completions are explicitly attributed to that session
quantities.aggregationRu: Суммировать distinct unit IDs только для одного курса/версии материала, вида единицы и state. Состояния одной единицы — отдельные non-additive views; attempted as a unit (≥1 attempt) не равно count of response_attempt events. Открытие/завершение/сдача не доказывают mastery; повторы после split не клонировать.
quantities.migrationNote: No automatic migration: previous label bundled unit completion with attempts/opening; identify old state before any conversion.
quantities.coreMapping: Integer Measurement stores one manually counted unit-type/state aggregate per SESSION/SEGMENT. Unit kind/state can be namespaced via separate Metric IDs, but course/material version, unit identity, state transitions and unique units are absent.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM only for same material version/unit type/state over disjoint units. Opening/attempted/completed/mastered cannot share one additive total; BY_TARGET keeps target-level record.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: Full state transition/dedup needs unit identity, material version and state dimension; no automatic inference from duration.

quantities.definitionRu: Счётчик отдельных ответов на card/question или попыток решения practice item; one response/attempt is one event, not a distinct vocabulary word, card mastered or problem solved. Attempted/correct/incorrect can be separately user-defined states, but no correctness field is necessary.
quantities.unit: response or attempt (one declared unit type)
scope: response event
session/day/object-set if explicitly chosen
quantities.aggregationRu: Суммировать unique response events within same deck/material version and task type. Anki’s review means one answer of a card; one card may produce several review events, and one note may generate several cards. Do not multiply by cards/sets or equate cards with words.
quantities.coreMapping: For a known session/task, exact integer aggregate count of response or attempt events fits Metric INTEGER, unit response/attempt, SESSION or SEGMENT. Distinct Metric IDs can separate event types; per-response identity/material is unavailable.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM works for disjoint explicitly counted attempts under one definition; repeated answer can legitimately count again. It must not be conflated with unique cards/words or item mastery. BY_TARGET retains each target.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: No new schema for a manually known session total. Per-response material/card identity or event dedup needs added event targets.

quantities.nameRu: Количество слов с явным basis и объектом текста
quantities.definitionRu: Optional word-count family: every value identifies a text/version and exactly one counting basis. A document snapshot, session net change, session gross additions, source-side translation words, target-side delivered words, and reviewed/processed words are distinct quantities and must not share an unqualified total. Never infer session-written words from the final document length.
quantities.unit: word (tokenization/language rules declared or application-defined; language and source/target side are explicit where relevant)
scope: document/text/version snapshot
one timer session and selected text with an explicit session basis
source-side or target-side text for one translation task/version
quantities.aggregationRu: Do not add snapshots across time or versions. Session counts add only for distinct non-overlapping text ranges/sessions with same basis/text/version identity. Source-side and target-side translation counts use separate variants; do not sum the two. Net change may be negative; use a signed metric if retained. Review/processed count requires a rule for revisits and overlapping text spans.
quantities.coreMapping: Metric INTEGER/maxScale=0 with unit.word can store nonnegative word totals; different bases need distinct Metric IDs/versions. Measurement has only SESSION/SEGMENT targets and no text/version/basis dimension.
quantities.coreAggregation: SUM is only safe for compatible additive bases and disjoint same-lineage text/session totals. BY_TARGET preserves the target row, not document snapshot semantics. Signed net delta fails current Decimal and Dataset validation.
quantities.exactGapOrBoundary: Use 6 explicit basis variants below; snapshots and signed net deltas require schema semantics, and other bases are aggregate-only without text identity.

wordCountVariants.definitionRu: Количество слов в одном конкретном документе/версии в один момент. Пример: в выбранном тексте 2 340 слов при закрытии сессии. Это состояние текста, не слова, написанные за сессию.
wordCountVariants.aggregationRu: Показывать выбранный/latest snapshot; не суммировать снимки по дням или версиям.
wordCountVariants.coreStatus: pending_for_aggregated_core: SUM would be invalid; requires snapshot time, text identity and a non-additive/latest-state rule.

fixture.example: document D / version v7 / snapshot 2026-10-11: 2,340 words
fixture.numericShape: 2,340 is nonnegative INTEGER and fits a Measurement; one session-scoped record has no document/version/snapshot timestamp, and SUM across snapshots is invalid.

wordCountVariants.nameRu: Чистое изменение числа слов за сессию
wordCountVariants.definitionRu: Разница между размером выбранного документа в конце и начале сессии. Пример: 2 300 → 2 420 = +120; 2 420 → 2 380 = −40.
wordCountVariants.aggregationRu: Суммировать signed deltas only for non-overlapping sessions and identical text/version lineage; reorganization across files or baseline reset needs explicit handling.
wordCountVariants.coreStatus: not_supported_by_current_core: core metric values are non-negative; no signed delta or safe merge/split rule.

fixture.numericShape: +120 fits, but Decimal("-40") and validate() reject negatives; requires signed values plus document lineage/baseline.

wordCountVariants.definitionRu: Число слов, внесённых в выбранный текст в течение одной сессии according to an explicit chosen rule. Пример: вставлено/введено 500, затем удалено 320: gross additions = 500, while net change = +180. Whether pasted text, moved text, duplicated text and rewrites count must be explicit.
wordCountVariants.scope: one session + exact text target + selected insertion rule
wordCountVariants.aggregationRu: Can add across non-overlapping sessions only when insertion/deletion/paste/revision policy is unchanged; not derived from final document total.
wordCountVariants.coreStatus: numeric non-negative shape fits, but basis/identity semantics and actual counter source are pending; do not claim the current editor feature measures gross additions.

fixture.example: one session: 500 inserted, 320 removed; gross additions=500, net=+180
fixture.numericShape: 500 fits as integer word count. Metric ID can identify gross-additions basis; no insertion event, text identity or paste/move/rewrite policy is encoded. SUM only if user chose a stable rule and distinct sessions.

wordCountVariants.definitionRu: Word count of one source-language text/version for a defined translation task. Пример: источник 500 слов. It is not the translated target length.
wordCountVariants.scope: source document/version or explicitly non-overlapping source passage within one translation task
wordCountVariants.aggregationRu: Count source text once per unique source passage; do not count the same passage again for revision/retranslation unless the user method counts passes.
wordCountVariants.coreStatus: numeric shape supported; separate basis ID and source text/version/segment identity required before reliable roll-up.

fixture.example: translation task T1: source version v1 = 500 words
fixture.numericShape: 500 fits. Separate fieldId from target count; session aggregate is possible, but source text/version/span/task ID is not stored.

reusedExistingDefinitions.coreMapping: Integer event-record total can be entered per session/segment; core cannot hold distinct observation-record identities or the trip/site/record set. Do not substitute specimens, taxa, photographs, individuals or instrument readings.

reusedExistingDefinitions.ruleRu: Reuse same new-output semantics across art, work and education; do not count edits as a new artifact.

reusedExistingDefinitions.ruleRu: Reuse only same planting/crop amount and site semantics; production/business status remains context.

reusedExistingDefinitions.ruleRu: Reuse same aggregate by animal group/site/product/time; no per-animal attribution required.

reusedExistingDefinitions.coreMapping: Integer trip-event total fits; trip identity is not a Session/Segment identity, and stops, distance and elapsed duration remain different measures. Reuse exact trip count rather than create another.

reusedExistingDefinitions.ruleRu: Reuse only for explicit repeated executions of the same named exercise/movement and compatible session/set boundary. Do not reuse for flashcard answers, card reviews, language repetitions, completed units or arbitrary workflow retries; those have distinct semantics.

sessionScopedFixture.purpose: Disambiguate intended whole-target Measurement behavior; analytical trace from source, not test execution.
sessionScopedFixture.data: One session S has Segment A on date D1 (09:00–09:10, classification detail phase=write) and, after pause/resume or a details change, Segment B on D2 (09:00–09:10, phase=review). One SESSION Measurement E=5 (for example, five explicitly counted events across the session) targets S.
sessionScopedFixture.computedFromReportsCode: D1 report filtered to phase=write selects A, derives sessionIds={S}, and includes E once. D2 report filtered to phase=review selects B, derives sessionIds={S}, and includes the same E once. quantityTotals() on each individual report returns 5 if E metric is SUM.
sessionScopedFixture.documentedMeaning: Each 5 is labelled as the whole session S, not 5 events in the write phase or review phase. Summing the two classification reports produces 10 as repeated whole-target views; the API contract warns not to add overlapping/classification/daily report slices. Because one session total cannot be attributed to one of its two detail phases, consumers must show the whole-target label and avoid claiming phase-level breakdown. This is intentional target semantics, not an implementation defect under the documented contract.
sessionScopedFixture.classification: intentional whole-target behavior, not defect under the documented contract. A client that promises period/event-specific totals would need those counts attached to explicit event/window targets; prorating a discrete count by duration is not valid by default.
sessionScopedFixture.readOnlyOnly: No test, runtime fixture, code change, build or installation performed.
